description:
Multi-item cart spanning inventory models; combos/packages with bundle pricing; parking and merchandise cross-sell attached to ticket purchases.

**Conditions of Success:**
- One cart mixes tickets, lodging, parking and merch and checks out atomically (all-or-nothing holds)
- Combos price as a bundle and decompose correctly for settlement/refunds
- Cross-sell suggestions configurable per event/venue

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).

**Amended (grilling):** scope includes a refund-protection add-on (buyer-paid insurance as a cross-sell line item) with its own refund/settlement semantics — coordinate with TKT-9 refund flows.

comments.body: COS defined at epic level. Not yet decomposed — US-stories are created when the owner prioritizes this epic (Gate 1), per PRD 'Capability map'.
Backlog grilling 2026-07-12 (owner decisions): refund-protection add-on added to cross-sell scope.
